Into the bell in the 1500m and they've shed the pacemaker, Stu' Paton (entry fee sponsored by Oliver Foote to set up a sub 4!) Mark Sinclair looks a picture of relaxation and goes on to a sixth successive win. The next three hung on for pb's - Olly, Frank Ward (behind Mark) and John Booth in his seasonal debut after injury!

Even so we had some winners with Stu' Paton maintaining our 400m 'A' record and helping us to victory in the long relay. Chris Knight continued to do a good job in the low hurdles with good back up from Gareth Allison who found he could high hurdle as well and competed in 5 events during the afternoon.
One lap completed for Stu' Paton at Petersham and plenty of time before having to think about putting in that famous "kick".
With Stu' Paton 8th in 31:11 and Jon Hobbs 12th in 31:45 the Bels took 4th team place. Young Steve Willimont ran to a 76:20 half-marathon at Fleet on March 22nd.
- Stu' Paton, on his return to the Hall one Sunday morning, worn to a shadow after a 57 minute cross-country '10' with John Ngugi and Richard Chelimo's younger brother.
